name: bug-fixer
description: Understand a free-form bug report and apply a minimal fix for that instance, without writing the lesson or committing.

inputs.name: bug-report
inputs.description: Unstructured bug report (sentence, failing case, review comment, stack trace, or tool finding).

outputs.name: fix-summary
outputs.description: What the defect was, where it was, and what changed. When the location is ambiguous, return one blocking question instead.
